note: v1 97.51 (seeds 0/11 97.51/97.67), first draft of JUNGLE-TINGED LIQUID, 'Wet Brick': liquid with jungle in its bones. wM's amen-chops plays the whole amen in its own order, and the fourth bar of every phrase is EDITED like an MPC take - odd slices reversed, the snares re-pitched up, the last beat doubled into sixteenths at +7 and +12, and in the second drop stuttered into a roll; the edits grow through the track. Under it an 808 boom whose long notes glide between roots, a dubby juno pad on Fm9 - Dbmaj7 - Ebsus2 - Cm7 four bars a chord, a Rhodes answering each chord into a dotted-quarter echo, and a low wordless voice in the break. Levels on the album standard: -13.3 LUFS, true peak -1.2 dBTP, longest pinned run 1 (a low-knee soft clip after the fast compressor - recipe in sounds.md). 2:40.
